hypothesis: The N=64 force reference on data_seed 1 does not depend on the model seed. Fresh seeds 22-23 (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], 3000 steps, best-of-3 controls) reproduce seeds 20-21: final best-layer force margin about 0.209, trained force R2 about 0.74, force control about 0.53. This arm anchors the paired N=128 and N=256 data_seed 1 seeds 22-23 decomposition. All values are read from run-record probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded. Trained R2 is never taken from the max-over-layers trajectory field.
expected_if_true: In both seeds: final best-layer force margin in [0.18, 0.26] with beats_control true; trained force R2 in [0.68, 0.78]; force control R2 in [0.45, 0.58]; headroom-normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.78]; val_mse_ratio < 0.05.
expected_if_false: Either seed has a final force margin < 0.15, or trained force R2 < 0.65. Either result would mean the data_seed 1 N=64 force level depends on the model seed.
